tinley-park-il.whyCard3Body: Our phone line is open 24/7, including weekends and holidays. When a pipe bursts or water is coming into your basement, we work to get a local plumber to your home as soon as we can.

faq.q: How much is a plumber in Tinley Park?
faq.a: Not finding a price online is frustrating. We get it. The truth is that the cost depends on the problem, and clearing a slow drain is a very different job from fixing a sewer line. Quoting a number without seeing it would just be guessing. Instead, our plumber finds the cause first and then gives you a flat price before starting. You’ll know exactly what you’re paying before you say yes.

faq.q: What is the hourly rate for a plumber in Tinley Park?
faq.a: When a plumber charges by the hour, you pay for every extra minute and only learn the total at the end. That’s not how we work. You get one flat price for the whole job before we start, so it stays the same whether the repair takes one hour or three.

faq.q: How to tell if your plumber is overcharging you?
faq.a: Unless you work in the trades, it’s hard to judge whether a plumbing price is fair, or who to trust. That’s why we show you the problem before we put a price on it. If it’s hidden in a drain or sewer line, we send a camera down, walk you through what we see and answer your questions. Only then do you get a flat price, before any work begins. No pressure, just the information you need to decide.

faq.q: What to ask before hiring a plumber?
faq.a: Letting someone into your home for a repair you can’t double-check takes trust. Before you hire anyone, ask: Are you licensed in Illinois? Do you bill by the hour? Will I know the price before you start? Can you show me the problem? Our answers: we’re a registered Illinois plumbing contractor, we never bill by the hour, every job gets a flat price up front, and when the issue is hidden inside a line, we show you what we find.

faq.q: Can you do your own plumbing in Illinois?
faq.a: It’s a fair question if you like doing things yourself. Illinois allows it, but only in one situation: plumbing work on a single-family home that you own and live in, done to the state plumbing code and open to inspection. In Tinley Park, that work also needs a permit and inspection from the Village, so call the Building Department before you start. For a condo, or if someone else is helping you, the job has to go to a licensed plumbing contractor. If you’re unsure whether your project qualifies, give us a call.

faq.q: Are your plumbers licensed and insured in Illinois?
faq.a: Yes. All of our technicians are licensed, bonded and insured in Illinois, and J. Blanton Plumbing is registered with the state as a plumbing contractor.

faq.q: How quickly can you get a plumber to my home in Tinley Park?
faq.a: Our plumbers work out of our office on 185th Street, so we’re usually close by when you call from Tinley Park or the southwest suburbs. The line is open 24/7. Give us a call, and we’ll tell you an honest arrival window instead of a guess.

tinley-park-il.finalBody: Small leaks and slow drains don’t fix themselves, and a burst pipe can’t wait. Call us anytime, and we’ll keep a small problem from turning into a big one.
